output.summary: Bushy shrub or spreading tree native to south-eastern Australia. It has bluish-grey or silvery leaves and spherical heads of yellow flowers. Its leaves are sometimes used in Indian chutney, while Ngunnawal and Wiradjuri people traditionally made flour from the seeds.
